purpose: Non-gating compiled-library operation, baseline, and cleanup inspection evidence; subprocess counts, not latency acceptance.

instrumentation.method: Temporary Node driver wraps child_process.spawnSync and calls syncBuiltinESMExports; counting starts only after isolated Git fixtures are ready.

samples.scenario: cleanup plan with two eligible branches
cleanup execution deleting two confirmed branches

configurationCompatibility.scenario: Plain valid config: one resolveBaselines and one reportBaselines call over working tree, index, and HEAD
configurationCompatibility.result: Resolution objects, protected branches, source provenance, warnings, and refusals matched in all ten cases.

registrationCompatibility.method: Compare sorted selected-key entries from Git config --null --get-regexp with Git config --null --list filtered by the same exact key prefix.
registrationCompatibility.result: Selected registration snapshot entries matched in all five cases.

notes: No cross-inspection cache: every operation check and cleanup candidate revalidation queries Git again.
Per-marker filesystem observations, precedence, and strict inspection failures remain enforced.
Newline-containing Git directory paths retain individual lookups because Git emits newline-delimited paths.
Each baseline metadata source is still collected independently; one Git config parse supplies its path and branch values without caching across sources or inspections.
Elapsed times are omitted: the local host load was uncontrolled; complete-suite timings are recorded separately.
